name: cencurity-connector
description: Lightweight connector that downloads and launches the private Cencurity core binary.

commands.title: Cencurity Connector: Install or Update Core

cencurityConnector.manifestUrl.description: Publicly reachable release manifest URL that describes downloadable Cencurity core binaries. Leave empty until your public manifest is ready.

cencurityConnector.releaseChannel.description: Release channel name used by the connector for status display and manifest metadata.

cencurityConnector.binaryName.description: Optional explicit binary filename override if the manifest omits fileName.

cencurityConnector.host.description: Local host used when launching the downloaded Cencurity core.

cencurityConnector.port.description: Local port used when launching the downloaded Cencurity core.

cencurityConnector.openInSimpleBrowser.description: Open the local Cencurity dashboard in VS Code Simple Browser instead of the external browser.
